title.zh: 一个八音盒 = 一个音序器
title.en: A music box is a sequencer

lead.zh: 凸起转到梳齿，就响一个音。
lead.en: A pin reaches the comb: a note plays.

say.zh: 圆筒上的每个凸起，转到梳齿就响一个音。
say.en: Every pin on the drum plays a note when it reaches the comb.

say.zh: 把圆筒摊平：从左到右是时间，转一圈 16 格。这就是音序器。
say.en: Unroll the drum: time runs left to right, 16 steps a turn. That is a sequencer.

say.zh: 点格子加一个凸起，再听一遍。机器上，这 16 格就是右边的 4×4 GRID。
say.en: Tap a cell to add a pin and listen again. On Cardenza these 16 steps are the 4×4 GRID.

title.en: Four music boxes make a part

lead.zh: 一个乐器不够，就多买几个。
lead.en: One instrument is not enough: get more.

say.zh: 一个八音盒只有一种声音。
say.en: One music box has one sound.

say.zh: 再来三个：鼓、钢琴、和弦、贝斯，一起转。
say.en: Add three more: drums, piano, chords, bass, all turning together.

say.zh: 每个八音盒是一条轨道，它转的那一圈叫 Pattern。四轨一起转，就是一段完整的乐句。
say.en: Each box is a track, and its loop is a pattern. Four tracks together make a whole phrase.

title.zh: 很多段排起来 = 一首歌
title.en: Parts in a row make a song

lead.zh: 一段只有几秒，歌要长得多。
lead.en: A part lasts seconds; a song is longer.

say.zh: 一段只有几秒钟。
say.en: One part lasts a few seconds.

say.zh: 多做几段，从左往右一段接一段地播。
say.en: Make a few parts and play them one after another, left to right.

say.zh: 这就是一首歌（SONG）。在机器上，它在 {{scene:TAPE}} 场景里排。
say.en: That is a song. On Cardenza you arrange it in scene {{scene:TAPE}}.

say.zh: 左边 8 列是琴键：按一下，出声。
say.en: The 8 columns on the left are the keyboard: press one to play.

steps.demo: tap r2c1; wait 12; tap r2c3; wait 12; tap r2c5

say.zh: 右边 4×4 对着屏幕中间的格子：点一个，选中它。
say.en: The 4×4 on the right matches the cells on the screen: tap one to pick it.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}} 或 {{key:SUB}}：改它的值。边弹边改，就听得出来。
say.en: {{key:ADD}} or {{key:SUB}} changes its value. Play while you turn it.

steps.demo: tap SUB; tap SUB; tap SUB; tap ADD

say.zh: 最左、最右各 4 个键，对着屏幕两边的竖条：左边管去哪里，右边管改值和播放。
say.en: The 4 keys at each edge match the strips at the screen's sides: the left ones move around, the right ones change and play.

lead.en: Play the keys, change the sound.

say.zh: 弹琴键：第 1、3 行是白键，第 2、4 行是黑键。
say.en: Play: rows 1 and 3 are the white keys, rows 2 and 4 the black keys.

steps.demo: tap r2c1; wait 10; tap r2c2; wait 10; tap r2c3; wait 10; tap r1c2

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}} 或 {{key:SUB}}：换一个音色，名字在屏幕最上面。
say.en: {{key:ADD}} or {{key:SUB}}: another sound. Its name is at the top of the screen.

say.zh: 再弹一下，听听新音色。
say.en: Play again and hear the new sound.

steps.demo: tap r2c1; wait 10; tap r2c3; wait 10; tap r2c5

lead.zh: 大界面叫场景，场景里有好几页。
lead.en: The big screens are scenes; each has pages.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}}：下一个场景。{{scene:INSTR}} 音色 → {{scene:SEQ}} 音符 → {{scene:TAPE}} 编排。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}}: the next scene. {{scene:INSTR}} sound → {{scene:SEQ}} notes → {{scene:TAPE}} arrangement.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:ESC}}：屏幕变成地图。按住不放，再按 GRID 的一列，直接去那里。
say.en: Hold {{key:ESC}}: the screen becomes a map. Keep holding and press a GRID column to go there.

steps.demo: down ESC; wait 30; shot; tap G4; up ESC

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：这个场景的下一页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the next page of the scene.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:CTRL}}：这个场景的所有页都在 GRID 上，按一个就去。
say.en: Hold {{key:CTRL}}: every page of the scene is on the GRID; press one to go.

steps.demo: down CTRL; wait 30; shot; tap G1; up CTRL

lead.zh: 四条轨道，四种乐器，各有颜色。
lead.en: Four tracks, four instruments, a colour each.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:TAB}}：下一条轨道。屏幕最上面的颜色跟着变。
say.en: Tap {{key:TAB}}: the next track. The colour at the top of the screen follows.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}}：一列一条轨。按住不放，按第 1 行的格子去那条轨。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}}: a column per track. Keep holding and press a top-row cell to go there.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; shot; tap G3; up TAB

say.zh: 回到 {{track:1}}：鼓。
say.en: Back to {{track:1}}: the drums.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; tap G1; up TAB

say.zh: 按住底鼓键（左下角），再点 GRID 1、5、9、13。
say.en: Hold the kick key (bottom left) and tap GRID 1, 5, 9 and 13.

steps.demo: down r3c1; wait 20; tap G1; tap G5; tap G9; tap G13; shot; up r3c1

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}}：绿线走到哪一格，哪一格就响。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}}: each step plays as the green line reaches it.

say.zh: 按住军鼓键（第 2 列），点 GRID 5、13。边放边写。
say.en: Hold the snare key (column 2) and tap GRID 5 and 13, while it plays.

steps.demo: down r3c2; wait 20; tap G5; tap G13; wait 20; shot; up r3c2

say.zh: 再按 {{key:PLAY}}：停。写好的会自动留着。
say.en: {{key:PLAY}} again stops. What you wrote is kept.

lead.zh: 选一个调，弹什么都在调上。
lead.en: Pick a scale; whatever you play stays in it.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:ESC}}，按 GRID 第 1 列：进入 {{scene:SETUP}}。
say.en: Hold {{key:ESC}} and press GRID column 1: {{scene:SETUP}}.

steps.demo: down ESC; wait 30; shot; tap G1; up ESC

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}，翻到 KEYS 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}} until the KEYS page.

say.zh: 点 SCALE（GRID 2），按 {{key:ADD}}：换一个音阶。
say.en: Tap SCALE (GRID 2) and press {{key:ADD}}: another scale.

say.zh: 点 LAYOUT（GRID 1），按 {{key:ADD}} 换成 SCALE：每个键都在调上，怎么按都不会错。
say.en: Tap LAYOUT (GRID 1) and press {{key:ADD}} for SCALE: every key is in the scale, no wrong notes.

say.zh: 弹一弹，再单击 {{key:ESC}} 回去。
say.en: Play a little, then tap {{key:ESC}} to go back.

steps.demo: tap r2c1; wait 10; tap r2c2; wait 10; tap r2c3; wait 10; tap ESC

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：到 CHORD 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the CHORD page.

say.zh: 点 GRID 1 选一种和弦，再按一个琴键：一下就是一个和弦。
say.en: Tap GRID 1 for a chord, then press a key: one press, a whole chord.

steps.demo: tap G1; wait 10; down r2c1; wait 10; shot; up r2c1; wait 10; tap r2c3

say.zh: {{key:CTRL}} 到 ARP 页，点 GRID 1：打开琶音。
say.en: {{key:CTRL}} to the ARP page, GRID 1 turns the arpeggiator on.

say.zh: 按住一个琴键：和弦的音一个一个弹出来。
say.en: Hold a key: the chord's notes come one after another.

steps.demo: down r2c1; wait 60; shot; wait 20; up r2c1

say.zh: 这是 {{scene:TAPE}} 的 SONG 页，每一列是一段。点 + 那一列：加第一段。
say.en: This is the SONG page of {{scene:TAPE}}; each column is a part. Tap the + column: the first part.

say.zh: 再点 + 那一列：第二段，和第一段一样。
say.en: Tap the + column again: a second part, the same as the first.

say.zh: 第二段的 {{track:1}} 格已经选中（白框）。按 {{key:ADD}}：换成 P02，另一个鼓点。
say.en: {{track:1}} in part 2 is already picked (white frame). Press {{key:ADD}}: P02, another beat.

say.zh: 点第一段（GRID 1），按 {{key:OK}}：SONG 模式从这一段开始。再按 {{key:PLAY}}：整首歌播起来。
say.en: Tap part 1 (GRID 1) and press {{key:OK}}: SONG mode, from this part. Then {{key:PLAY}}: the whole song plays.

steps.demo: tap G1; tap OK; wait 10; tap PLAY

say.zh: 听：第二段鼓点变了。{{key:PLAY}} 停。
say.en: Listen: the drums change in part 2. {{key:PLAY}} stops.
